mostWorthwhile.text: Making the first star was the strongest moment: the cloud-to-star sequence paid off, while the fusion explanation distinguished the mythic gesture from real physics.

leastWorthwhile.text: The stretch of only one offered combination at a time made progress clear but left little meaningful choice, especially while mist’s role was still unclear.

surprise.text: Earth and dust producing gravity surprised me; its explanation as a force that both gathers matter and causes collisions made the result more intriguing.

arbitrary.text: Adding air to the first star to make a starfield felt somewhat arbitrary: the result describes the pattern repeating, but air’s role was not clear.

continue.text: Yes. The galaxy’s question about what a star can give besides light makes me curious about how the world and life might follow, though I would hope for more meaningful choices.
